package streamidentity_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	chunks "example.com/streamidentity/gen/chunks"
	events "example.com/streamidentity/gen/events"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	watchStream struct {
		value *chunks.Chunk
	}
	followStream struct {
		value *events.Other
	}
	audit struct {
		t *testing.T
	}
)

func TestExternalAndOrdinaryResultDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	chunk := &chunks.Chunk{Value: "Watch"}
	other := &events.Other{Value: "Follow"}
	watch := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
		return watchStream{chunk}, nil
	})
	follow := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
		return followStream{other}, nil
	})
	client := events.NewClient(nil, watch, follow, audit{t})
	ctx := context.Background()
	mixed, err := client.WatchStream(ctx, &events.WatchPayload{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	got, err := mixed.Recv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Same(t, chunk, got)
	require.Equal(t, "accessed-Watch", got.Value)
	require.NoError(t, mixed.Close())
	ordinary, err := client.Follow(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := ordinary.RecvWithContext(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Same(t, other, result)
	require.Equal(t, "accessed-Follow", result.Value)
	require.NoError(t, ordinary.Close())
}

func (s watchStream) Recv() (*chunks.Chunk, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (s watchStream) RecvWithContext(context.Context) (*chunks.Chunk, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (watchStream) Close() error {
	return nil
}
func (s followStream) Recv() (*events.Other, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (s followStream) RecvWithContext(context.Context) (*events.Other, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (followStream) Close() error {
	return nil
}
func (a audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *events.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	res, err := next(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return res, err
	}
	value := i.ClientStreamingResult(res)
	require.Equal(a.t, i.Method(), value.Value())
	value.SetValue("accessed-" + i.Method())
	return res, nil
}
